summary.en: Turn raw wedding footage, audio, and Pic-Time stills into a full documentary wedding film, ceremony & speeches edits, 1-minute trailer, and tagged vendor reels — graded, verified, and published.

details.en:
Best for: Hudson Valley & Catskills documentary wedding productions (Canon C-Log3 video + Sony stills).
What it does: Loads your measured film-style-analyzer profile, pulls edited day-of stills from Pic-Time MCP for ACEScct color matching, builds 5 OpenFilm projects (highlight film, ceremony, speeches, 1-min trailer, vendor reels with on-screen tags), validates pacing against your profile, and publishes to R2, Mux, your website, Pic-Time, Metricool MCP, and Meta Ads MCP.

needs.en: Node.js 22+, FFmpeg, film-style-analyzer (local profile in ~/.film-style-analyzer/), plus optional MCP servers: Pic-Time, Metricool, Meta Ads.

permissions.project: Reads raw wedding video/audio folders, writes OpenFilm project folders (film.html, pages, looks/*.ctf), and renders MP4 deliverables.
permissions.program: Runs film-style CLI for clip scoring and timeline comparison, ffmpeg/ffprobe for audio sync checks, and helper scripts for R2/Mux publishing.
permissions.network: Connects to Pic-Time MCP, Cloudflare R2, Mux Video API, Metricool MCP, and Meta Ads MCP when publishing or fetching stills.
